section_summary: Pages 80–117 continue a printed compilation of Securities and Exchange Commission rules under the Securities Act of 1933. They cover exempt offerings, registration statements, prospectuses, accounting requirements, filing, amendments, and withdrawal. Pages 118–119 contain a February 1940 release announcing Regulation S-X and amendments to investment-company registration forms.

subfiles.title: Securities Act of 1933: General Rules and Regulations
subfiles.about: Rules govern securities offerings, registration statements, prospectuses, financial disclosure, and filing procedures.
subfiles.summary: The section begins mid-rule with suspension and amendment procedures for offering sheets, then sets out Regulation B-T exemptions for interests in oil royalty trusts. Regulation C provides requirements for registration statements and prospectuses, including provisions for foreign-government securities, financial statements, accountants, confidential contracts, fees, filing, amendments, and withdrawal. Pages 100–101 repeat text appearing on pages 98–99.

subfiles.title: Release announcing Regulation S-X and amendments to Forms 15 and 17
subfiles.about: The Commission announces uniform accounting requirements and amendments to investment-company registration forms.
subfiles.summary: The release announces Regulation S-X, a unified set of financial-statement requirements for specified registration and reporting forms, and explains its effective dates. It also announces amendments to Forms 15 and 17 requiring historical information about capital shares.
